name: task
title: Tasks
description: Give a member of the conversation a task, or ask a person for an approval. Assignees accept, report progress, finish or reject; the author cancels. Unanswered tasks are poked.

commands.name: task
commands.help: Give a member a task: /task @webapp fix the two Safari tests

args.name: poke
args.help: first reminder after this long without an answer (default 4h)

commands.name: approval
commands.help: Ask a person for a yes or no: /approval @can ship 2.0 tonight?

cancel.label: Cancel
cancel.confirm: Cancel this task? The assignees are told to stop.

tools.name: task
tools.description: Tasks on the bus. op=create gives members of a conversation a task (kind=task) or asks people for a yes/no (kind=approval); it is posted at once. op=mutate acts on a task message: accept, progress, done, reject (as an assignee) or cancel (as its author). Approvals are answered by people only.

kind.description: create: task, or approval (a yes/no from people)

conversation.description: create: where to post it: a conversation id, #room, or @agent for its DM

to.description: create: who does it; members of that conversation, without @

text.description: create: what to do, or the question

poke.description: create: first reminder after this long without an answer, e.g. "2h"; "off" for none; default 4h

action.description: mutate: what to do with the task

note.description: mutate progress: how far you are

eta.description: mutate progress: done in about, e.g. "40m"; no poke before then
